Maya (CS Ops): short request 6: need enablement to POST a completion webhook so CS can auto-log activity + optionally bump healthscore.
Diego (Eng Backend): can do. prefer to push into ops-api /webhooks/enablement so we can map contacts and owners immediately.
Maya (CS Ops): yes /webhooks/enablement. required fields: account_id, training_id, nps, feedback. opt-outs per-account for compliance.
Mina (Product): also include training_version and curriculum_tag if available. product wants to track health deltas by curriculum.
Sam (CS Manager): want the delta to be gated: +10 default but only applied after 14 days unless churn signal seen. backfill for last 90 days.
Diego (Eng Backend): plan: idempotent POSTs, X-RW-Signature HMAC, X-RW-Idempotency. sample payload below:
```
POST /webhooks/enablement
Headers: X-RW-Signature: sha256=..., X-RW-Idempotency: <id>
{
  "account_id": "acct_0a1b2c",
  "user_id": "u_9876",
  "training_id": "onboard-live-v2",
  "training_name": "Redwood Live Onboarding",
  "training_version": "v2.1",
  "nps": 10,
  "feedback": "Instructor was great, examples were directly applicable",
  "duration_minutes": 90,
  "event_ts": "2026-03-20T14:22:00Z"
}
```
Diego (Eng Backend): idempotency key recommendation = sha256(account_id + training_id + event_ts). retry policy 3x with exp backoff. rotation plan for signing secret: quarterly rolling, support X-RW-Signature-V2 during transition.
Maya (CS Ops): request: when webhook received create CRM activity type "Enablement: completion" with note including feedback and who submitted. tag account `enablement.received` and set pending score +10. apply +10 after 14 days if no negative signals.
Mina (Product): add feature-flag `ff.enable_enablement_immediate` to allow immediate scoring for a canary org (org 654321). metrics wanted: NPS distribution, delta on renewal_risk over 30/90 days.
Diego (Eng Backend): will add feature flag, canary rollout steps, and an admin dry-run backfill endpoint: `/admin/backfill/enablement?days=90&dry_run=true`. backfill will export CSV with columns: account_id, owner_id, owner_email, received_ts, nps, training_name, opt_out_flag.
Sam (CS Manager): CSV with owner mapping is crucial so CS can prioritize outreach. also include a direct link to account in CRM export.
Maya (CS Ops): need an opt-out enum: none | legal | privacy. if opt-out present we should still log activity but not alter healthscore.
Diego (Eng Backend): noted. audit metadata will include `meta.source=enablement`, `meta.idempotency_key`, and `meta.raw_payload_reference`.
Mina (Product): small ask: include `instructor_id` or `instructor_name` to analyze instructor effect.
Diego (Eng Backend): will add optional instructor fields. timeline: PR by Thursday EOD, internal dry-run backfill Friday, canary next Tuesday to org 654321 for 7-day metrics watch, then full rollout & backfill if no regressions.
Maya (CS Ops): please include a sample HMAC verification snippet in PR and a sample webhook file so ops can test locally.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-1987: Enablement webhook + backfill (assignee Diego).
Diego (Eng Backend): will attach test script and sample payload in PR. thanks everyone.
Maya (CS Ops): will compile backfill owners list and opt-out exceptions and post here once ready. :thumbsup:
